checks.name: Fixed plan stays accurate on a custom circuit; native keyboard disclosure changes no saved state; mismatch status precedes choices; Test applies the stated fixed change and Undo restores the edited bench
All3 setup plans show only fixed inputs/components; dark sensor varies relative light while divider and other settings stay fixed; tested evidence keeps its one existing replay status
Keyboard baseline/result replay ignores inactive-only differences for manual and sensor circuits, preserving exact state/Undo/Redo; a true electrical replay remains undoable
Imported prediction uses its fixed lesson plan while preserving the imported live circuit; import and locale rerenders never redirect focus
